hypotheses.title: Quarterly Sales Surprise Momentum Conditioned on Earnings Certainty (analyst4 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits post-earnings announcement drift (PEAD) and sell-side analyst anchoring bias using quarterly reported net sales (actual_sales_value_quarter). Comparing reported quarterly sales against trailing 1-year mean isolates top-line fundamental surprise. Conditioning on earnings certainty isolates robust cash-backed compounders and completely decouples from options volatility and price-volume datasets.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during broad cyclical turning points where high-growth sales compounders compress violently on multiple contraction.

hypotheses.title: Composite Factor Score Intraday Momentum and Cashflow Quality (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: composite_factor_score_derivative tracks multi-factor intraday style momentum and earnings quality across 100% of US equities. Longing firms with high multi-factor momentum and superior operational cash generation captures institutional consensus upgrades without touching options or price-volume datasets.
confounders: Rapid intraday market rotation between value and growth
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms when intraday multi-factor momentum signals reverse aggressively during macro regime shifts.

hypotheses.title: Growth Potential Expansion Conditioned on Earnings Certainty (model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: growth_potential_rank_derivative measures medium-term expansion trajectory in corporate revenues and operating earnings. Conditioning on earnings_certainty_rank_derivative filters out speculative high-beta growth traps, isolating reliable structural compounders under pure single-line industry neutralization.
confounders: Unforeseen regulatory changes in financial accounting
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during market-wide multiple contractions where expensive high-growth equities suffer systemic deratings.
